task: Display the figure comparing unemployment trends among women in Illinois and Michigan.
agent_final_answer: Displayed the figure comparing unemployment trends among women in Illinois and Michigan. On americashealthrankings.org I opened the "Unemployment - Women" measure, set the location to Illinois, then used the "Compare States" control to add Michigan. This produced the "Unemployment - Women Trends" State Comparison line chart, which plots Percentage of the female civilian workforce that is unemployed by Data Year (2017-2023) with two distinct lines labeled Illinois and Michigan. Both states track closely: about 4.7% in 2017, declining to ~3.7-3.8% by 2018-2019, spiking to ~9.6% in 2020 (COVID-19), then falling to ~5% in 2021, ~4.2% in 2022, and ~4.0-4.1% in 2023. Source: U.S. Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics, Local Area Unemployment Statistics Program.
